neighbours.label: a stated upper limit or maximum (max, maximum, no more than, at most), as against minimums and the same quantities stated without any limit
fire: The little boat can carry six passengers max, so two of us waited ashore.
Under the old law, no settler could claim more than ninety acres.
The ticket allows a maximum stay of thirty days in the country.
Each guest may bring at most two bags onto the bus.
The elevator holds 800 kilograms max, according to the sign.
Nobody was permitted to borrow more than five books at a time.
The fine for littering can reach a maximum of five hundred dollars.
The cable supports 20 amps max before the fuse trips.
quiet: The little boat can carry six passengers, and all of us went aboard.
Under the old law, every settler had to claim at least ten acres.
The ticket requires a minimum stay of three nights at the hotel.
Each guest brought two bags onto the bus.
The elevator weighs 800 kilograms, according to the sign.
Everyone was asked to borrow at least one book each week.
The fine for littering is usually fifty dollars.
The cable is 20 metres long and painted grey.
